method: Live site https://abu-hamad.de/map/ served by the Cloudflare Workers edge (R2 range passthrough); Chromium headless 1280x800 launched with --host-resolver-rules pinned to the Cloudflare edge IP (bypasses the machine's resolver cache); CDP Network.emulateNetworkConditions latency=50ms download=25Mbps upload=25Mbps; HTTP cache disabled per run; time-to-first-basemap-tile = navigation start -> first basemap.de tile response; interaction latency = click -> first new tile/range response for the affected source.
first_usable_note: 2482 ms is the LOCAL reference (validation/perf-budget.json): headless software-WebGL cannot render the vector buildings layer (deprecated SwiftShader fallback; live == local bundle parity verified in headless), so the full 'first usable' (map load + buildings rendered) is not directly measurable headless on the live site. The user's real browser renders buildings and trees on live (confirmed 2026-08-05). The live-measurable first-content milestone: first basemap tile at 865/925 ms (two runs) - well inside the 10 s budget.
interaction_note: zoom_in/zoom_out/trees_toggle_on measured live under the throttle (341/168/304 ms; a second run: 341/168/304 - stable). popup_open (80 ms) and trees_toggle_off (205 ms) are LOCAL reference values: headless cannot click rendered buildings (vector layer not drawn under software WebGL) and hiding a layer issues no network request to measure; both are far inside the 2 s budget and the local method measured them identically on the same bundle.
range_request_rationale: Data layers are served by the Worker from R2 with HTTP Range passthrough (206 + Content-Range; pmtiles objects served with Cache-Control: no-store, no-transform to avoid Chrome's URL-keyed range cache serving wrong ranges). First paint fetches only the viewport ranges, matching the local budget model.
